plan: The bug is in the uncertainty calculation: the bootstrap resamples raw observations and compares their unadjusted mean shear, so its interval does not quantify the same smoothed, matched-width contrast reported by the main analysis. I’ll resample contiguous blocks of the joint time series and recompute the growth-versus-decline contrast within each replicate, including width-overlap checks. I’ll also use the actual elapsed-time spacing for lag differences and report the bootstrap interval as descriptive uncertainty for this single aggregate, not as replication-level inference.
